- Accept `sqlite:path` and `sqlite::memory:` in the CLI alongside the existing `sqlite://` forms, including offline migration SQL export. [PR #1588](https://github.com/riverqueue/river/pull/1588).
- Reject empty SQLite paths in commands that connect to a database; bare prefixes remain valid for offline migration SQL export. [PR #1588](https://github.com/riverqueue/river/pull/1588).

### Fixed

- Accept `sqlite:` and `sqlite://` URLs with both Active Record and Sequel, including `:memory:` databases, while preserving the `sqlite3:` aliases. [PR #1588](https://github.com/riverqueue/river/pull/1588).
- Reject empty SQLite paths in commands that connect to a database; bare prefixes remain valid for offline migration SQL export. [PR #1588](https://github.com/riverqueue/river/pull/1588).

### Fixed

- Accept `sqlite:path` and `sqlite::memory:` in the CLI alongside the existing `sqlite://` forms, including offline migration SQL export. [PR #1588](https://github.com/riverqueue/river/pull/1588).

- Normalize `sqlite://` URLs before opening JDBC connections so relative paths remain relative and `sqlite://:memory:` opens an in-memory database. Preserve `sqlite:` and native `jdbc:sqlite:` URLs. [PR #1588](https://github.com/riverqueue/river/pull/1588).
- Reject empty SQLite paths in commands that connect to a database; bare prefixes remain valid for offline migration SQL export. [PR #1588](https://github.com/riverqueue/river/pull/1588).
- **Upgrade note:** `sqlite://var/lib/x.db` now opens `./var/lib/x

### Added

- Expose `Client.QUEUE_DEFAULT` (`"default"`) for queue configuration and operations, matching the default queue constant in other River clients. [PR #1557](https://github.com/riverqueue/river/pull/1557).

### Fixed

- Isolate batch peer decoding failures so valid peers continue working, preserving each failed peer's own error through handler failures and completion retries. [PR #1586](https://github.com/riverqueue/river/pull/1586).

- Fixed maintenance services logging errors during normal shutdown or leadership loss, including `PeriodicJobEnqueuer` reporting `Error starting transaction: context canceled` when stopped during staggered startup. Genuine query timeouts and database failures are still logged, and periodic job transactions now roll back even after cancellation. [PR #1577](https://github.com/riverqueue/river/pull/1577).

### Added

- Add `riverqueue migrate-get` to export Postgres or SQLite migration SQL without a database connection, with Go-compatible version selection, exclusions, ordering, schema substitution, and migration headers. [PR #1584](https://github.com/riverqueue/river/pull/1584).

- Fixed Postgres maintenance, including reindexing, reporting a failure when a query error raced with shutdown or leadership loss. Successful query results, including commits, are preserved. [PR #1577](https://github.com/riverqueue/river/pull/1577).

- Fixed maintenance services logging failures during shutdown or leadership loss when a driver returned a socket or SQL error instead of the cancellation reason. Genuine query timeouts and database failures are still reported. [PR #1577](https://github.com/riverqueue/river/pull/1577).

- Reduce database overhead in the Active Record and Sequel drivers: use `RETURNING` to avoid redundant row fetches, claim batches and clean up finalized jobs in one statement, and omit unnecessary transactions. Return Active Record connections to the pool after operations and avoid allocating models for job reads. Avoid slow Postgres fetching-index scans for updates and deletes targeting a job by ID when state statistics are stale. [PR #1574](https://github.com/riverqueue/river/pull/1574).

- Elasticsearch and OpenSearch support is unchanged. SearchClient is now the reference implementation of the interface.
Pluggable sinks: write to any target, not just Elasticsearch
- PGSync can now sync to targets other than a search engine, such as ClickHouse, a warehouse, or a queue.
- Quirks that only apply to Elasticsearch, such as the legacy _type field on versions below 7, now live inside the sink instead

- Add Sync.make_search_client(), extra_setting(), and extra_mapping() hooks for customizing the search client and index
  settings/mappings via subclassing (backward compatible).
- Expose RedisQueue.client for direct access to the underlying Redis/Valkey client.

- Fixed Redis metadata writes in multi process setups by storing metadata as field-level Redis hashes instead
- Expanded test coverage across sync, query builder, transforms, plugins, Redis queue, search client, and
database base behavior.

- Import/export dialogs close after success; import cancellation is silent.
